English

Generated Narrative: CodeSystem KGL2DMNClasses

This case-sensitive code system http://smart.who.int/base/CodeSystem/KGL2DMNClasses defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
dmn-definitions DMN FileOne DMN file as a unit -- the `dmn:definitions` root. Shares its IRI with the l1:external-artifact for the same file, so the l2:decision-support-logic component that points at it and this subgraph name one resource.
dmn-decision DMN DecisionA `dmn:decision` -- the question being answered, and the node that carries the link back to the BPMN task invoking it. A file may hold several; the BCG file holds one.
dmn-decision-table DMN Decision TableThe table realising a decision. Separate from dmn-decision because DMN permits other expression kinds -- a literal expression, an invocation -- and collapsing the two would make the graph unable to say which was used.
dmn-input-clause DMN Input ClauseAn input column. Its expression text is where data element names are embedded, which is the only reason this is a node rather than a property of the table.
dmn-output-clause DMN Output ClauseAn output column. The BCG table's four are Care Plan, Guidance displayed to health worker, Annotations and Reference(s). These are column DEFINITIONS in a decision table, not clinical records: no edge from this class reaches an execution artefact, and none may.
dmn-rule DMN RuleOne row. Its input and output cells are carried as properties, not nodes: 250 of them in the BCG table alone, none the target of a cross-model edge. What the rule needs a node for is its citation edge into L1.
